line.s1_sq_small.text: And mine is small. But it's sweet!

line.s1_compare.text: Your big apple is bigger than mine. And my small apple is smaller than yours.

line.s1_daily.text: It's the same at home. Mum has big shoes and you have small ones. Your shoes are smaller.

line.s2_thirsty.text: I'm thirsty! Which cup is for me?

line.s2_fox_asks.text: Squirrel has little paws. Can you help her choose?

line.s2_wrong.text: That is the bigger cup. Look for the smaller one.

line.s2_thanks.text: Thank you! The small cup fits my paws.

line.s2_summary.text: The small cup is smaller and the big cup is bigger. Great!

line.p_intro.text: Now a game. I'll show you two things and you choose.

line.p_click_biggest.text: There are three. Point to the biggest.

line.p_click_smallest.text: There are three. Point to the smallest.

line.a_fox_game.text: Let's play a home game! I show a thing and you say if it is bigger or smaller than my paw.

line.a_fox_plate.text: A plate. Bigger or smaller than my paw?

line.a_sq_bigger.text: Bigger! The plate is bigger than your paw.

line.a_sq_smaller.text: Smaller! The cookie is smaller than your paw.

line.a_sq_your_turn.text: Your turn. We'll show two of the same thing, one big and one small.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to play this with you at home. Look for things bigger and smaller than your hand!

line.s1_pick_bigger.text: I'm very hungry. Point to the bigger apple, that one is for me.

line.s1_wrong.text: That is the smaller apple. Look for the bigger one.

line.s1_fox_thanks.text: Thank you! A big apple for a big hunger.

line.s3_sq_flower.text: I want to put a flower behind my ear. There are two flowers.

line.s3_fox_too_big.text: The big one is bigger than your head! It won't stay.

line.s3_pick_smaller.text: Point to the smaller flower. That one fits behind my ear.

line.s3_wrong.text: That one is too big. Point to the smaller one.

line.s3_sq_thanks.text: It fits! The small flower is smaller than my ear.

line.s4_fox_ball.text: Shall we play ball? The biggest one is best for kicking.

line.s4_sq_three.text: There are three balls: small, medium and big.

line.s4_wrong.text: There is a bigger one. Look for the biggest.

line.s4_fox_thanks.text: Yes! The biggest ball. Let's kick!

line.s5_sq_cookies.text: Snack time. I have two cookies: a small one and a big one.

line.s5_fox_hungry.text: I am big and very hungry!

line.s5_pick_bigger.text: Point to the bigger cookie. That one is for Fox.

line.s5_wrong.text: That is the smaller cookie. The bigger one is next to it.

line.s5_sq_mine.text: And the smaller cookie is for me. Just right.

line.s5_summary.text: Bigger for the bigger one, smaller for the smaller one. Yummy!

line.s0_wind.text: Oh, what a wind! The apple tree is shaking. Look out, something is falling!

line.s0_fell.text: Hop! Two apples fell down. One big, one small.
